questions.question: A fully managed message queuing service that enables you to decouple and scale microservices and distributed systems. It stores messages until a consumer processes and deletes them.
A serverless event bus service that connects application data from your own apps, SaaS apps, and AWS services, enabling event-driven architectures with routing rules and schema discovery.
A fully managed pub/sub messaging service that fans out messages to a large number of subscribers including SQS queues, Lambda functions, HTTP/S endpoints, and email addresses simultaneously.
A visual workflow service that lets you coordinate the components of distributed applications using state machines. It orchestrates sequences of tasks with built-in error handling and retry logic.
A cloud-based email sending service designed to help digital marketers and application developers send marketing, notification, and transactional emails at scale.
A no-code integration service that enables bi-directional data flows between AWS services and SaaS applications like Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Slack, on a schedule or triggered by events.
A managed message broker service that supports industry-standard messaging protocols such as AMQP (ActiveMQ) and STOMP (RabbitMQ), enabling migration of existing message brokers to the cloud.

A fully managed GraphQL API service that simplifies application development by letting you create flexible APIs so applications can access, manipulate, and receive real-time updates from multiple data sources.
